rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: it characterizes sample_03 with the metrics actually available (library size, detected genes, count concentration, within-group correlation, PCA/heatmap position), keeps it in the primary DESeq2 Wald fit with Cook's flagging, and runs the with/without fits plus voomWithQualityWeights and edgeR robust, reporting overlap and genes that flip status. The removal criterion is stated as a technical one to be judged in QC but is not fixed numerically in advance (e.g. a MAD threshold), which is a small gap against the reference. Filter (>=10 in >=5), in-model median-of-ratios/TMM normalization, explicit relevel and contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm and lfcThreshold-in-test are all correct and explicit. Enrichment was not asked for; it is nonetheless specified properly (full ranked list by Wald stat, named collections with recorded version, 15-500 window, seed, tested-gene universe for any ORA), so it is docked only for scope beyond the question and for recording rather than pinning a version up front.
